rows.en: ＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０１０Oh... you startled me.＝＠１７４＿０１１You're still here, too.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０１３Oh... I'm sorry.￥I didn't think anyone￥was here...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０１４I'm... just carrying￥some cargo...＝＠１７４＿０１５I've just finished one load.＝＠１７４＿０１６But I thought I'd￥do a little more...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０１８I was only doing it as￥extra training...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０２０But... I'm not there yet.￥If this little bit is enough￥to wear me out...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０２１I'm not very strong.￥So I want to build up as￥much as I can, even now...＝＠１７４＿０２２Hauling this cargo is￥my own kind of training.

＊Tomoe＊...＝＠１７４＿０２３Since I'm here as a candidate,￥I don't want to take it easy...＝＠１７４＿０２４Because... I want to go to Elan.＝＠１７４＿０２５The chance to reach my dream￥is right in front of me. I can't￥just relax...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０２６Real greenery and land,￥untouched by human hands...＝＠１７４＿０２７Reaching out and touching that￥kind of powerful life with my￥own hands...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０３１You're right.￥We've been blessed with￥an amazing chance.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７４＿０３２It feels like a waste￥not to try my hardest.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿００１So... it's not hard￥for me, and...＝＠１７５＿００２I... I'm going to keep up￥this training a little￥longer today.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿００３I have to try harder...￥or I'll never catch up to￥every... one...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿００５I'm sorry...＝＠１７５＿００６You must be tired too,￥after your own training...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿００８But...￥that's not good enough.￥I won't catch up to everyone...

＊Tomoe＊...＝＠１７５＿００９I can't just sit still.＝＠１７５＿０１０I can see how hard￥everyone is working...＝＠１７５＿０１１I don't want to be left behind￥just because I didn't try￥hard enough.＝＠１７５＿０１２At this rate, I might even let￥down the people who believed in￥me and sent me here...＝＠１７５＿０１３I couldn't bear that...!＝...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿０１４I'm sorry for causing you￥so much trouble today.
